description: Detects repeated failed logins for one user from one source IP in a short window, consistent with password guessing against a single account.

detection.logic_plain_english: Count failed login events grouped by user and source IP. Alert when any group reaches 5 failures within any rolling 10-minute window.

false_positive_notes: Users who genuinely forget a new password can trip this. Tune by excluding known corporate egress IPs or raising the threshold for interactive SSO sources; always pair with the success-after-failures rule (DET-005 style correlation) before escalating.
name: Brute force login attempts against a single account
